items.text: Library and information science (LIS) is a separate field from Information Science Engineering; this guide covers the BLIS/MLIS, librarian, archivist, and knowledge-management side specifically.
Most articles on this topic default to listing government and school librarian roles first because they are the most familiar.

Law firms, consulting firms, pharma R&D, media houses, and BFSI companies hire information specialists to run internal knowledge bases, manage paid database and journal licensing, and build taxonomy and search systems for thousands of employees.

visuals.heading: BLIS/MLIS Entry Routes and Eligibility

rows: Bachelor of Library and Information Science (BLIS)

A 1-year professional degree open to graduates of any discipline (a Bachelor's degree in any subject is the eligibility, not a specific stream). Some universities also run a 3-year integrated BLIS after Class 12.
Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS)

1-2 years after a BLIS (or, at some universities, directly after any Bachelor's degree). This is the usual minimum qualification for librarian and information-officer posts, not just library-assistant roles.
UGC-NET for Library and Information Science

A national-level qualifying exam conducted by the NTA. Required for Assistant Professor (library science) posts and, at most universities, for university and college librarian posts specifically, alongside the MLIS.
M.Phil / Ph.D in Library and Information Science
Optional, but relevant for senior academic-library leadership roles and for anyone aiming at teaching library science itself at a university.

blocks.heading: Real Pay, Track By Track
rows: School Librarian / Library-In-Charge (Entry)
Roughly Rs 2-4 LPA
Library Assistant / Junior Librarian (Public, Academic, or Corporate Library)
Roughly Rs 2.2-4 LPA
School Librarian / Library-In-Charge (Entry)
Roughly Rs 2-4 LPA
Library Assistant / Junior Librarian (Public, Academic, or Corporate Library)
Roughly Rs 2.2-4 LPA
University or government librarian (post-MLIS, post-UGC-NET)
Roughly Rs 5.5-9 LPA, following a government pay-matrix scale for the specific post and institution
Senior/chief librarian or university librarian (large institution)
Roughly Rs 10-18 LPA at senior pay-matrix levels, reached after years of service and, usually, a promotion-linked selection process
Corporate knowledge manager / information specialist (BFSI, consulting, pharma, law)
Roughly Rs 6-16+ LPA depending on employer size, seniority, and how much of the role covers information governance and systems work versus pure library operations
Independent information/taxonomy consultant or digital-archiving contractor
Highly variable and project-based; not a fixed band, since it depends on client base, niche, and track record
